blockingIssues.description: Lint rule `delegateToPattern` captures generic natural-language terms after 'delegate ... to' and raises false undefined-role errors.
Missing-success-criteria detection treats the phrase 'completion criteria' as sufficient evidence and can suppress required warnings when no concrete criteria are defined.
Prompt stack API creates a new `VersionStore` per request while store locking is instance-local, allowing concurrent lost updates/history corruption.
Prompt layer editor lacks the required markdown/text syntax-highlighting behavior and remains a plain textarea.

appliedUpdates.description: Added architecture note that `VersionStore` mutex scope is instance-local and handlers should reuse a shared store instance for concurrent safety.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Clarify whether strict tests-first/red-phase ordering is mandatory or best-effort, and align enforcement text with actual mission execution expectations.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: prompt-stack-lint transcript shows implementation edits before first targeted test run, conflicting with current skill wording.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Allow mission-level overrides for scoped Playwright runs and manual checks when AGENTS guidance explicitly marks full-suite/manual validation as non-blocking or currently unstable.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: prompt-stack-ui review found skill requires full `npx playwright test` + manual verification while mission AGENTS requires scoped specs due known unrelated failures.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Clarify the '~200 line React component' guideline with explicit exceptions/expectations for complex control-plane pages and preferred decomposition checkpoints.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: prompt-stack-ui implemented a 1115-line page while guidance says keep components around 200 lines; rule appears non-enforced/ambiguous.
